description: Yield-curve PCA tool based on Huggins & Schaller, Fixed Income Relative Value Analysis (2024), Chapter 3, Box 3.1. Fits level / slope / curvature factors to generic government yield curves via eigendecomposition of the covariance matrix of yield levels (not changes), then models each factor as an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process for mean-reversion analysis and trade-idea generation.
bloomberg_fetch: bdh — generic government yield index tickers, field PX_LAST, periodicity WEEKLY
fallback: Three-factor OU simulation using Nelson-Siegel-inspired loadings
note: All Bloomberg tickers below are generic government yield indices. Verify each ticker in Bloomberg Terminal before production use. Spain tickers have a 'YR' suffix (e.g. GSPG2YR); US tickers also use 'YR' (USGG2YR); UK tickers use a 'Y' suffix (GUKG2Y). GDBR15 / GDBR20 off-the-run liquidity may be limited — consider switching to GDBR15 Index or the benchmark bond once verified.

default_bpvs.description: Approximate BPV (basis-point value) per 100mn notional, used as defaults in the trade builder. Based on typical modified durations for each tenor. Verify and refresh periodically.

verification_checklist: Run blp.bdh(['GDBR2 Index', ...], 'PX_LAST', start, end) to confirm Bund tickers return data
Confirm GBTPGR{t} tickers for Italy (alternative: GBTPGR{t} vs GBTP{t} — check terminal)
Confirm Spain GSPG{t}YR suffix is consistent across all tenors
Confirm US USGG{t}YR series is available at 15Y and 20Y tenors
Confirm UK GUKG{t}Y suffix (note: no 'R') is consistent across all tenors
Confirm GDBR15 and GDBR20 Index are available and liquid
